content: We ran BV2009 with smaller window sizes for each of our different batch sizes. Our results are summarized for a window size of one in the row ``BV2009 (Window Size = 1)'' in Table~ SECREF4 . When using a window size of one, BV2009 is able to stop with a smaller number of annotations than when using a window size of three. This is done without losing much F-Measure. The next subsection provides an explanation as to why smaller window sizes are more effective than larger window sizes when larger batch sizes are used.
